The ability can stack multiple times. |spawned_by = *[[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] *[[Mystery Boss]] (Hardcore, wave 44 onwards) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Speedy King''' was a large and fast [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. For its debut, it has high health and fast speed. It has an ability where upon death, it can make surrounding enemies faster, if there are any enemies in a certain proximity. This speed-boost affects [[Boss]] enemies like the [[Fallen Swordmaster]]. The '''Speedy King''' can be spawned by the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]. The [[Mystery Boss]] can spawn the '''Speedy King''' in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, from wave 44 onwards. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current '''Speedy King''' is identical to its original version, except it has two slanted lines perpendicular to each other as its face. |Original |The original '''Speedy King''' looked similar to the [[Speedy Boss]]'s third version and fourth version appearance. It had light blue skin and wore reflective blue shoulder-pads and arm-pads. Its torso and legs were dark blue granite. It wore blue boots with white socks, a slightly slanted blue crown, symbolizing royalty, and a dark blue cape. Blue electricity can be seen emitted from its legs and arms. It was faceless. }} ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Invisible''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *The [[Military Base]]'s [[units]] can be effective against the '''Speedy King''' as it can escape the range of towers before it can be killed. *High DPS towers, such as [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Turret]], and [[Minigunner]] are recommended to kill it. *The [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] cannot freeze or slow down the '''Speedy King''', as it has [[Freeze Immunity]]. **Stalling towers such as the [[Warden]] and [[Trapper]]'s bear traps can only slow down the [[Speedy King]], instead of completely stopping its movement while knockback towers cannot knock it back. ***Additionally, the [[Warden]] can only slow down the '''Speedy King''' for a short amount of time due to its large size. *Upon death, the '''Speedy King''' can speed up other enemies around it with its ''Charge'' ability. **This makes it a very big threat, especially if a major boss such as the [[Fallen Swordmaster]] is present. **The '''Speedy King''' often spawns in groups and alongside the [[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]], increasing the number of enemies that can speed up other enemies. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} SpeedyKing.png|First version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSpeedyKing.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} OverhualUpdate.png|'''Speedy King''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Entity System - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Speedy King''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} OverhaulIconClean.png|'''Speedy King''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} HardcoreBadge2.png|'''Speedy King''' on the Triumph Hardcore [[badge]]. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexSpeedyKing.png|'''Speedy King''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Speedy King''' has a death animation where it raises one arm, then slumps to the ground. *The '''Speed King's''' ''Charge'' ability is nearly the same as the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] [[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]]'s ''Super Charge'' ability and the same as the [[Polluted Wasteland II]] [[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]]'s ''Short-Circuit'' ability. *The '''Speedy King''', alongside the [[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]] from [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, the [[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] from [[Polluted Wasteland II]] and the [[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] from [[Pizza Party]], are the only enemies that are capable of speeding up other enemies. *The cape used by the '''Speedy King''' is the {{RLinkC|4750345950|Blue Royal Cape}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *This may be considered the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] version of the [[Speedy Boss]]. *The crown that the '''Speedy King''' uses is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|1078202|Black Iron Crown of Pwnage}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Speedy King''' added. **{{Bug}} Its ability can cause frozen enemies to start moving temporarily. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **Appearance changed. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **[[Energy Immunity]] replaced with [[Stun Immunity]]. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Speedy King''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **No longer appears in the [[Index]]. {{Hardcore|[[Error]]|Wave 42|Speedy King & [[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]]|Wave 43|[[Molten Titan (Legacy)|Molten Titan]] & [[Molten Boss]]|Wave 44|category = hide}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Speedy King}}
